response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js, cloud, and testing/craftsmanship credentials, plus recent hands-on work with MCP code generators and agentic-workflow tooling at re:cinq. However, the role demands 8+ years building production AI-driven solutions, and his GenAI exposure appears limited to roughly the past year, with no demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent framework experience on the resume. He could grow into the role, but he does not currently meet the core AI depth requirement for a Staff FDE position.
strengths: 15+ years of production software experience across web, backend, and embedded, including staff-level roles
Recent hands-on MCP and AI-agent infrastructure work aligned with agentic workflow responsibilities
Strong customer-facing and mentoring track record via consulting, workshops, and conference talks
concerns: Falls far short of the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions (~1 year of GenAI work)
No evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM evaluation/observability experience
Limited demonstrated depth on major cloud platforms beyond AWS CDK usage in one role

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering seniority and mentorship
